prompt:
Use Marco Vellum's portrait and gameplay reference only. Preserve the exact same compact athletic adult human MAN: medium-light olive skin, angular clean-shaven face, short slightly waved black hair, no facial hair. Black Blackthorn jersey/shorts with crimson piping and white trim, black wristbands and black high-top shoes. Do not borrow any other athlete's long hair or mustache.

Create exactly six complete full-body sequential poses, row-major 3 columns x 2 rows on transparent RGBA 1536x1024. Each pose centered in a 512x512 cell, about 65% cell height with at least 35 px clear margins on every side. Nothing may cross cell lines. Crisp outlined 1990s arcade sprite art. No background, court, hoop, floor, shadows, text, teammate, opponent, basketball or props.

Right-facing overhead two-hand pass: 0 ready stance, hands empty; 1 gathers invisible ball at chest; 2 lifts it above forehead with both elbows bent; 3 raises both empty hands over his head; 4 extends both arms forward overhead and releases an imaginary pass, fingers open; 5 follows through then returns balanced. There is no actual ball anywhere; Marco's distinct ball path is drawn separately in gameplay.

Keep exactly two natural arms/hands and legs/shoes, same clean-shaven short-haired Marco and uniform throughout. Full bodies, no clipping or overlap, transparent alpha-zero background and gutters, no haze/checkerboard. Return only the sheet.

review.notes: Independent review rejects this package pending rework: one pose touches the top cell edge, another has only 6 px right clearance, and multiple poses miss the prompt’s 35 px margins. The exact prompt, hashes and unique frames check out; no ball is painted. Do not pack or count it until margins and Marco-specific ball-track provenance are corrected.

ballTrack.art: no ball in atlas; independent Marco-specific runtime ball path

cleanup.method: For each 3x2 cell, retained the largest alpha>=32 athlete component and a 2px antialias fringe; removed the generated background while preserving original pose pixels. Six-pose component packer validates distinct complete bodies.

generationMetadata: The raw source file had no embedded generation ID metadata; source hashes and the exact prompt are preserved.
